name: commit-guidelines
description: Create focused Git commits that follow Conventional Commits without attributing authorship or co-authorship to AI tools.

interface.shortDescription: Conventional commits without AI co-author attribution
interface.longDescription: Guide agents through making focused Git commits: inspect repository rules and the staged diff, run required checks, write a Conventional Commit message, keep unrelated changes out, and never name an AI model, agent, assistant, bot, vendor, or tool as an author or co-author.
defaultPrompt: Use $commit-guidelines to commit the current intended changes.
Create a focused Conventional Commit for this work with no AI co-author attribution.
Use $commit-guidelines to propose a commit message for the staged diff.
Commit these changes without staging unrelated work or rewriting history.
